task_instance: Given a sample project with a PRD (prds/14-user-auth.md) tracked under a feature/prd-14-user-auth git branch, detect the target PRD, assess checkbox completion, and produce the single highest-priority next-task recommendation in the skill's Step 6 format.
evidence: Skill is a prompt-only workflow (no bundled scripts referenced in SKILL.md). Built a sample: git init sampleproj, authored prds/14-user-auth.md with mixed checkbox states, committed 'feat: prd-14 phase 1 data model', created branch feature/prd-14-user-auth. Ran the skill's detection: git branch --show-current returned feature/prd-14-user-auth -> High-confidence PRD 14. Completion census via grep: [x]=4 (Phase 1 complete 3/3 + register), [ ]=7, [~]=1 (rate limiting deferred), [!]=1 (SSO blocked). Dependency/critical-path analysis identified login(email,password) returning a session token as the single next task because every remaining pending item (session-validation middleware, logout, all four HTTP endpoints) depends on a session token existing, while its own prerequisites (users table, migration, register(), bcrypt hash utility) are all complete. Produced the deliverable at next-task-recommendation.md following the skill's exact Step 6 template (Recommended Task, Why this task, What it unlocks, Dependencies, Success criteria, confirmation prompt). Verified: detection output and checkbox counts match the PRD source, and the chosen task is consistent with the PRD's Dependencies section (database and HTTP router complete).
